parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a dimly lit warehouse interior filled with tall metal racks holding stacked crates and pallets. The floor is concrete, and a forklift is partially visible behind racks. Pallets are stacked on the right, and blue plastic crates line the left. Lighting is sparse, creating shadows and depth.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall blue metal rack on the left, holding multiple levels of blue plastic crates and wooden crates. It extends from near the bottom to the top of the frame, partially obscuring background elements. Appears freestanding on concrete floor.

objects.label: blue plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked in rows on the left rack, appearing as uniform blue rectangular containers. Located at mid-to-top height of the rack. Partially occluded by other items and shadows. Supported by the rack structure.

objects.label: wooden crates
objects.observation: Brown wooden crates stacked on the same rack as blue crates, positioned higher up. Some have white labels. Occluded by adjacent racks and lighting. Resting on metal rack supports.

objects.label: stacked wooden pallets
objects.observation: Tall stack of weathered wooden pallets on the right side of the frame. Positioned against a wall or another rack. Visible from ground level to near the ceiling. Not touching any other objects directly.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift partially visible behind the central rack, mostly obscured by metal structures. Its rear section and part of its mast are visible. Appears stationary. No direct contact with other objects visible.

objects.label: yellow and black striped barrier
objects.observation: Small yellow and black striped safety cone or barrier placed on the floor near the base of the central rack. Positioned between the rack and the aisle. Contacts the concrete floor. Not attached to anything else.
